customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated with `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` in workflows (cargo install pins and similar).

packageRules.description: ubuntu-26.04 is not an available GitHub-hosted runner label yet (runner versions use docker versioning, so a regex instead of a range). Lift this once GitHub lists it.

Heavy automerge for everything: the CI suite (fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests against real OpenSCAD + Linux and macOS app builds + cargo-deny + dependency-review + CodeQL + Trivy) is the safety net, so anything that stays green merges itself.
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into one PR.
GPUI Kit crates and the GPUI snapshot they pin must move together. tree-sitter is deliberately not a direct dependency: it comes through gpui-kit.
Protocol crates: group ACP schema and tree-sitter grammar bumps so protocol changes land in one reviewed-by-CI PR.
